proposals.title: actor re-activation must not panic (single-use / error-not-panic)
proposals.detail: Actor::activate(&self) does not consume self and re-activation after a deactivate cycle panics via .expect(...) at actor.rs:610/617. Return a typed ActorError, or consume self on activate.
